batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c RR Rossouw b I Sharma

batting.name: SM Curran
batting.dismissal: c Aman Hakim Khan b P Dubey

batting.name: Harpreet Brar
batting.dismissal: c MR Marsh b Kuldeep Yadav

batting.name: RR Rossouw
batting.dismissal: c Sikandar Raza b Harpreet Brar

batting.name: Aman Hakim Khan
batting.dismissal: c Harpreet Brar b NT Ellis

balls.text: safe! Banged into the track on off stump. Raza has a swipe at it and top-edges it badly. The ball, though, lands right between short fine leg and deep backward square leg, allowing a brace

swing and a miss again! And Shahrukh is also run out at the bowler's end! Slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Shahrukh swings like a rusty gate and does not make contact. Raza calls him through for a bye but Shahrukh is nowhere in the frame as Salt relays it to Khaleel, who takes off the bails at the bowler's end!
low full toss on leg stump. Raza opens up his stance and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket. They think about the second before deciding against it

another excellent yorker that goes just beyond leg stump. Raza seems to move inside the line at the very last moment but the umpire does not deem it to be a wide. Raza reviews! Raza seemed to move his front foot inside the line and the third umpire reckons that the ball would have hit his pad had he not made that movement. The non-wide call stands!
full and well down the leg side. Raza does not get bat on it and the keeper does well to get something behind it. Called a wide by the umpire too!
clears the fence! Low full toss hung outside off stump and it is the width that makes this shot possible. Raza extends his arms and thrashes it over the extra cover!
slower delivery angled across just outside off stump. Raza has a wild swing at it but only connects with the fresh Delhi air
another low full toss on middle and leg stump. Raza drills it down the ground towards long on for one more run
low full toss on middle and leg stump. Shahrukh clears his front leg and heaves it towards deep backward square leg. Just a single, though
excellent yorker outside off stump. Shahrukh is late in bringing his bat down and is beaten for pace
low full toss on leg stump. Raza flicks it uppishly towards deep backward square leg for a single

Mukesh gets Prabhsimran! Low full toss angled into leg stump. Prabhsimran tries to be too funky and looks for the reverse ramp. Does not have the room to work with and in the end, the ball pings off his pads into the stumps. Take nothing away from this sensational innings, though!
yorker that hones in on the stumps. Prabhsimran can't get under it and can only chalk it back towards the keeper
yorker that follows the batter outside leg stump. Prabhsimran flicks it down the ground towards long on for one
length delivery just outside off stump. Prabhsimran looks for the scoop again but this time, does not make any sort of contact

hundred for Prabhsimran! What a knock this has been! Take a bow, young man! Low full toss outside off stump. Prabhsimran opens his bat face just a touch and squeezes it past backward point. Soaks in all the applause and he now has 102 out of the 153 PBKS have scored so far, simply stunning!
moves to 98! Full toss on off stump. Prabhsimran walks across his stumps very early and laps it past short fine leg for four!
very full delivery on off stump. Prabhsimran drills it back past the bowler. Long on runs to his left, shows off a bit of nifty footwork and saves a brace
full delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran drives it towards extra cover, who misfields and ends up conceding a couple of runs
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran goes back and jabs it towards point for a single
googly on a back of a length outside off stump. Prabhsimran does not pick it and closes his bat face early, getting a leading edge towards short third man
six more! Full, flat and down the leg side. All Prabhsimran has to do is use the pace and shovel it over the deep backward square leg fence!
short and wide outside off stump. Prabhsimran goes back, fetches it and bludgeons it over the bowler's head for another boundary!
quick and flat on a back of a length on middle and leg stump. Shahrukh punches it towards deep mid wicket to get off the mark. 113.1 kph that!

soft dismissal! Length delivery on middle and off stump. Brar is caught on the crease and then ends up offering the simplest of catches to extra cover. Not sure what Brar was trying there but either way, this PBKS experiment has fallen flat on its face!
shot! Slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Prabhsimran gives himself plenty of room and bangs it over the bowler's head for four!
dug into the track on leg stump. Brar is massive late on the pull and top-edges it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
low full toss outside off stump. Prabhsimran drives it towards backward point, where Marsh brings out the dive and saves a boundary
full delivery outside off stump. Brar throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep cover point to get off the mark
slower delivery on a full length on leg stump. Prabhsimran tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket for one
and Prabhsimran welcomes him with a boundary! Length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran stands up tall and crashes it over extra cover!
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Brar pats it gently towards short mid wicket
full delivery on off stump. Brar comes onto the front foot and flicks it towards short mid wicket

Curran perishes! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump that spins back into Curran and cramps him for room. He tries to advance and clear long on but just does not have enough room to work with. Splices it towards long on, where Aman does the rest!

dropped, oh dear! Full delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran has a swipe at it and gets a massive top edge. The ball swirls towards deep backward square leg, where Rossouw seems to misjudge it and in the end, does not get a fingertip to it
what a shot! Flighted into the slot outside off stump. Prabhsimran reaches out for it and thumps it over the bowler's head!
back of a length delivery outside leg stump. Curran goes back and helps it towards deep backward square leg for a single
dragged down on leg stump. Prabhsimran shimmies around his crease and pulls it away towards deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
into the stands! Flighted into the slot on leg stump. Prabhsimran gives himself plenty of room and mauls it over the longer deep mid wicket fence!
full delivery on leg stump. Curran tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket
flighted nicely on a length outside off stump. Curran goes searching for it and sees the ball rip past the outside edge
full delivery on middle and off stump. Curran gets a big stride forward and defends it back to the bowler
safe! Full delivery just outside leg stump. Prabhsimran backs away and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket. Fortuntately for him, it lands just in front of the fielder
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Prabhsimran eases it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery on off stump. Prabhsimran hangs back and cuts it past backward point for a couple of runs
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Curran shapes for the cut and scuffs it towards long off for one
full delivery on middle and off stump. Prabhsimran comes forward and pushes it down the ground for a single. Gets to his second IPL fifty too, with this one coming off 42 balls!
fired into the track on a length at the stumps. Prabhsimran defends
length delivery on leg stump. Curran works it towards deep mid wicket and canters across to the other end
length delivery on leg stump. Prabhsimran does not quite read it and plays all over it as the ball hits the flap of the front pad
four more! Googly on a back of a length outside off stump. Prabhsimran waits in his crease, opens his bat face and guides it past short third man
short and wide outside off stump. Curran cuts it towards deep cover point for one more run
back of a length delivery on off stump. Prabhsimran gets onto the back foot and punches it towards long off
tossed up on a length on middle and off stump. Prabhsimran lunges forward and blocks it back to the bowler
quick and flat on a length on middle and leg stump. Prabhsimran paddles it straight to the fielder at short fine leg. 113 kph that!
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Prabhsimran eases it towards deep mid wicket for another single
slow and very short outside off stump. Prabhsimran lets it go and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
short and wide outside off stump this time, Prabhsimran uses the crease well, opens his bat face and steers it past point for another boundary!
six more! In the slot outside off stump. Prabhsimran waits deep in his crease and smacks it flat over wide long on!
big shot! Half-tracker outside off stump that just sits up to be hit. Prabhsimran winds up and whacks it a mile over deep mid wicket!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Curran drops it into the leg side and ambles across to the other end
slower delivery dug into the track on leg stump. Curran nurdles it into the leg side and scampers across for a couple of runs
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Curran punches it down the ground for just another single
full and angled into leg stump. Prabhsimran plays all over it as the ball pings off the pads towards short fine leg
full delivery just outside off stump. Prabhsimran comes forward and blocks it back to the bowler
length delivery on leg stump. Curran comes forward and tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Prabhsimran works it towards deep square leg for one
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Prabhsimran goes back and helps it round the corner towards short fine leg
back of a length delivery fired down the leg side. Left alone and called a wide
back of a length delivery on leg stump that spins back and cramps Curran for room. Can only flick it towards mid wicket
full and wide outside off stump. Prabhsimran throws his hands at it and slices it on the bounce to deep cover point
length delivery on leg stump. Curran nudges it into the leg side and is intent on a brace. Decides against it after completing the first, though
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Curran lunges forward and defends it back to the bowler
shot! Full delivery just outside off stump. Curran gives himself just enough room and cracks it past extra cover for four!
full delivery just outside leg stump. Curran advances and has a mow at it but makes no contact. Luckily for him, it hits his back pad
length delivery darted down the leg side. Curran leaves it alone as the umpire indulges in a bit of exercise
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Curran hops back and knocks it down the ground for another single
safe! Length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran tries to heave it away over deep square leg but mistimes it so badly that it lands well short of the sweeper
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Curran goes back and punches it down the ground for one
back of a length delivery on off stump. Curran hangs back again and stabs it into the off side
full delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran plants his front foot and drills it down the ground towards long off
short and outside off stump. Prabhsimran cuts it straight to the fielder at backward point
length delivery just outside off stump. Curran gets onto the back foot and jabs it towards extra cover
back of a length delivery on off stump. Prabhsimran goes back and turns it into the leg side for one more run
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Curran comes forward and works it into the on side for a single
dragged down on off stump. Prabhsimran rocks back and pulls it away towards long on
length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran goes back and prods it towards the bowler
back of a length delivery on off stump. Curran goes back and knocks it down the ground for a single
length delivery on off stump. Prabhsimran goes deep into his crease and defends
very full delivery on off stump. Curran comes forward and digs it out towards long on for a single

Jitesh bites the dust too! Slowed up nicely on a length on off stump. Jitesh backs away and looks to go inside out. He is nowhere close to the pitch of the ball, though, and has a swish at it. The ball breezes past the bat and then thuds into the top of off stump!
length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran dabs it down to short third man and hares across to the other end
fuller and flatter on middle and leg stump. Prabhsimran tries to repeat the stroke but this time, cannot beat the fielder at point
goes all the way! Full delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran brings out the reverse and slams it over the backward point fence!
slower delivery on a length on middle and leg stump. Jitesh comes forward and flicks it towards mid wicket
shot! Full delivery just outside off stump. Jitesh marches down the track, gives himself room and flays it over cover point for four!
full delivery angled into the pads. Prabhsimran misses his flick as the ball flicks his back leg and bobbles towards the keeper. Jitesh is alert enough to sneak in a single, though
dug into the track outside off stump. Jitesh toe-ends his pull towards mid wicket but hits it far enough away from the fielder to collect a single
length delivery in the channel that nips away slightly. Jitesh has a nibble at it and is beaten all ends up

and he knocks Livingstone over! Length delivery slanted into middle and off stump. Livingstone comes down the track and looks to smash it into next week. Loses his shape completely, though, and gets nowhere close to the ball as it cannons into middle and off stump! Ishant waves Livingstone goodbye and PBKS are two down in the powerplay!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Prabhsimran hangs back and jabs it towards backward point
length delivery darted down the leg side. Prabhsimran does not get bat on it and the keeper can't come around to gather either. Five wides!
fired in on a length on middle and off. Prabhsimran defends into the off side
length delivery just outside off stump. Prabhsimran gets onto the back foot and taps it towards the bowler
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran goes back and defends into the off side
full delivery on middle and off stump. Prabhsimran gets down on one knee and heaves it over square leg for four!
big turn! Length delivery fired into off stump. The ball grips in the surface and rips past the outside edge
slower delivery on a length on off stump. Prabhsimran drops it into the off side and hares across to the other end
four more! Full delivery just outside off stump. Prabhsimran plants his front foot and muscles it past mid on for another boundary!
another off-pace delivery on a back of a length on leg stump. Prabhsimran continues swinging and does not get the purchase he is after. That might have hit him on the right forearm
streaky! Slower delivery on a full length on middle and off stump. Prabhsimran has a wild slog at it and gets a thick outside edge that loops up over short third man
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Prabhsimran gets up on his toes and taps it towards short extra cover
length delivery hung outside off stump. Prabhsimran comes down the track before opting to shoulder arms
off-pace delivery on a length on middle and off stump. Livingstone gets forward and pats it gently towards the bowler
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Livingstone waits in his crease and defends into the off side
edged and four! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Livingstone has a waft at it away from his body and gets a thick outside edge that flies past Salt
full delivery just outside off stump. Livingstone comes onto the front foot and pushes it down the ground

holes out to deep square leg, oh my! Full and angled into the pads. On most days, Dhawan would have smashed that into the stands. Today, though, he can only hit it straight down Rossouw's throat at deep square leg. Not the greatest delivery Ishant has ever bowled but both he and DC will not mind this wicket one bit!
and Dhawan greets him with a six! In the slot just outside off stump and Dhawan climbs into it! Gets his hands through the ball and sends it soaring over the long on fence!
length delivery on off stump. Prabhsimran presses half forward and defends into the off side
length delivery outside off stump. Dhawan throws his hands at it and chunks it off the inner half of the bat towards mid on for a single
length delivery on off stump. Dhawan lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
length delivery that slides down the leg side again. Dhawan misses his flick but the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length delivery angled into off stump. Dhawan gets behind the line of the ball and plays it back to the bowler
full delivery fired down the leg side. Dhawan does not get bat on it as the umpire calls it a wide
safe! Length delivery outside off stump. Prabhsimran advances and dangles his bat, slicing it just past backward point for a single
back of a length delivery on off stump that shapes in nicely. Prabhsimran is cramped for room and stabs it into the off side

PBKS win by 31 runs! Slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Kuldeep has a slog at it and gets it as far as where mid off would have been. With that, DC have officially been eliminated from the playoff race, while PBKS remain alive!
dropped! Slower delivery on a length outside leg stump. Mukesh marches down the track and heaves at it. Shanks it and Brar, diving forward at deep mid wicket, cannot hold on
full toss angled into the pads. Kuldeep flicks it towards deep mid wicket and trudges across to the other end
off-pace delivery on a length outside off stump. Kuldeep leaves it alone and hopes for the wide call. Does not get it, though
slower delivery on a full length on middle and leg stump. Mukesh swings for the hills and gets it right off the toe-end. Trickles down to long on
short and outside off stump. Kuldeep scuffs his cut towards deep point for a single
bumper on leg stump. Kuldeep advances and heaves it away towards deep mid wicket for another single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Mukesh comes down the track and toe-ends it on the bounce to long on
yorker on middle and leg stump. Kuldeep tucks it away towards deep backward square leg for one
another cutter on a length on leg stump. Kuldeep does not pick the change in pace again and flicks too early. Gets pinged on the back thigh for his troubles
slower delivery dug into the track on middle and leg stump. Kuldeep is way too early into his pull and misses it completely
full and slanted into the stumps. Mukesh works it away into the leg side and gets across to the other end
slower delivery on a length on leg stump. Mukesh turns it behind square on the leg side for one more run
back of a length delivery that slides down the leg side. Mukesh does not get bat on it as the umpire calls it a wide
off-pace delivery on a length outside off stump. Kuldeep chips it past extra cover and picks up another single
full delivery outside off stump. Mukesh continues swinging and hacks it towards deep mid wicket for a single
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Mukesh swings like a rusty gate and misses the ball by a considerable margin

Dubey misses, Ellis hits! Full, fast and this zones in on middle and leg stump. Dubey tries to tonk it into tomorrow but gets nowhere close to the ball. He is, in fact, beaten for pace and hears the death rattle soon after!
slower delivery on a length just outside off stump. Kuldeep dabs it down to short third man for a single
low full toss just outside off stump. Kuldeep gives himself room and pushes it towards extra cover before scurrying across to the other end
yorker just outside off stump. Dubey throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep cover point for one more run
length delivery on the pads. Kuldeep uses the pace and helps it round the corner to pick up a single
full delivery angled into middle and off stump. Kuldeep backs away a touch but can only poke it back to the bowler
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Kuldeep defends it back to the bowler
length delivery that slides down the leg side. Kuldeep does not get bat on it as the ball brushes the thigh pad and floats through to Jitesh
cutter on a full length outside off stump. Kuldeep drives it towards deep point and gets off the mark
slower yorker outside off stump. Kuldeep has to wait an eternity before dangling his bat and chopping it back towards the keeper

Ellis gets Aman! Slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Aman tries to muscle it over cow corner but does not time it at all. The ball spoons up towards deep mid wicket, where Brar runs in quite a bit from the fence and takes a low catch! Is that the game?
slower delivery on a length on middle and off stump. Dubey drops it into the off side and saunters across to the other end
length delivery outside off stump. Aman stands deep in his crease and drills it towards deep cover point for one
slower delivery on a back of a length on middle and leg stump. Dubey punches it just past the bowler and picks up another single
what a shot! In the slot on the stumps. Aman stands up tall and nonchalantly whips it over the deep mid wicket fence!
banged into the track on leg stump. Dubey hops up onto his toes and pulls it away towards deep backward square leg
slower delivery on a back of a length on off stump. Dubey taps it towards backward point
shot! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Dubey stays leg side of the ball and glides it past short third man for four!
slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Aman flat-bats it towards long off for a single
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Dubey hangs back and works it into the leg side for one
breaks the shackles! Full outside off and this is just in Aman's hitting arc. He frees his arms and carves it over extra cover for four!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Aman gets onto the back foot and pats it towards short extra cover
back of a length delivery outside off stump. It spins quite a bit again and Aman can't make contact with his attempted cut
a carbon copy of the previous delivery, although this one might have spun a little less. Still enough to beat the outside edge, though
length delivery just outside off stump that pitches and spits off the surface. Aman prods at it and sees the ball spin comfortably past the outside edge
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Aman lunges forward and defends it back to the bowler
length delivery outside off stump. Dubey comes forward tentatively and runs it down to short third man
full delivery outside off stump. Dubey drives it down the ground and Raza manages to get a hand to it
round-arm delivery on a length outside off stump. Dubey scuffs it back to the bowler
length delivery angled into the pads. Aman tucks it away towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Dubey works it into the leg side and collects a single
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Aman goes back and punches it down the ground for a single
big turn again! Length delivery just outside off stump. The ball grips and spins square, easily past the outside edge
full delivery outside off stump. Dubey gets forward and pokes it towards short extra cover
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Dubey goes feeling for it again and is beaten comfortably
flighted on a length outside off stump. Dubey has a fish at it and misses the ball by a country mile
full delivery just outside off stump that spins away. Dubey has a massive swipe across the line and only swats away a few flies in the process
edged and four! Full delivery just outside off stump. Dubey has a waft at it and gets a thick outside edge that dribbles through the vacant short third man region
full delivery on off stump. Aman pats it back to the bowler
length delivery just outside off stump. Aman comes half forward and prods it into the off side
full delivery on middle and off stump. Dubey comes forward and pushes it down the ground for a single
full delivery on leg stump. Aman plants his front foot and chips it down the ground towards long on
full delivery on leg stump. Dubey gets down on one knee and paddles it towards short fine leg for a single

and he cleans Pandey up with an absolute corker! Fired into the track on a length on middle and leg stump. The ball drifts into Pandey and he thinks he can work it to leg. The ball, though, grips and spins square past his bat. Smashes into the top of off stump and DC are in all sorts of trouble now!
googly on a back of a length on leg stump. Pandey goes back and helps it past the keeper for a single
flighted nicely on a full length outside off stump. Pandey goes feeling for it and is comprehensively beaten on the outside
full delivery just outside off stump. Aman dabs it towards backward point and gets off the mark
tossed up on a full length just outside off stump. The ball grips in the surface and rips past the outside edge again
peach! Length delivery outside off stump that spins away sharply. Aman has a nibble at it and misses the ball by quite some distance

one brings two, two brings three! Full delivery on middle and leg stump. Axar has a swish at it but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. It goes past the bat and pins him on the front pad. Axar has reviewed this and he would hope it has spun enough to miss leg stump. No bat involved, as expected, but Ball Tracking shows that the ball would have kissed the outside of leg stump. Umpire's Call and DC are now five down!

huge appeal, not given! Full delivery fired into leg stump. The ball goes past the bat and hits Warner on the pads. That might have pitched outside leg, though, and that is why the umpire has given it not out. PBKS want to check upstairs! No bat involved, according to UltraEdge and the ball has pitched in line. It goes on to hit leg stump too, and Warner has to walk back!
full delivery outside off stump. Warner comes forward and drives it straight to short extra cover
poor from Brar! Short and way down the leg side. Warner waits in his crease and helps it past short fine leg for another boundary!
length delivery down the leg side. Warner looks for the sweep but does not get the purchase he is after
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Axar goes back and punches it down the ground for a single

holes out to deep mid wicket! Given a bit of air on a full length on leg stump. Rossouw advances and tries to mow it over long on. The bat face, though, closes on impact and he arrows it straight down Raza's throat at deep mid wicket!
back of a length delivery down the leg side. Some more exercise for the umpire

oh! Another googly on a back of a length outside off stump. Rossouw has no clue about it and dangles his bat. The ball loops up off the top edge and lands just in front of Arshdeep at short third. Could he have gone for the catch? That ball seemed to be suspended in the air for quite some time!
shot! Length delivery on middle and off stump. Rossouw brings out the reverse sweep and nails it past short third man for four!
length delivery on leg stump that spins back sharply. Rossouw looks for the cut but is, in the end, cut in half as the ball hits him on the pads
googly on a length outside off stump. Rossouw lunges forward and defends into the off side
length delivery darted down the leg side. Rossouw does not get bat on it as the umpire indulges in a bit of exercise

huge appeal, and given! Full delivery fizzed into off stump. Marsh looks for the cute, little paddle again but this time, gets into a slightly awkward position. Does not make contact as the ball pins him on the pads. After deliberation, Marsh decides to review! The impact might be the only thing under consideration here. Nothing on UltraEdge, as expected. It is Umpire's Call on Impact and the ball is just about clipping the off stump! Marsh has to go!
and he nearly gets a wicket first ball! Dragged down on leg stump. Warner heaves it and it almost carries to Shahrukh at deep mid wicket. Fifty for Warner, though - his 60th in the IPL!
full delivery on middle and off stump. Marsh comes onto the front foot and defends it towards short extra cover
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Marsh squirts it into the leg side and places it well enough to dash back for the second
full delivery on off stump. Warner comes forward and drives it down the ground for one
full delivery outside off stump. Marsh gets down on one knee and paddles it towards fine leg to get off the mark

knocks him over! Slightly quicker and this might have been a little shorter than the previous one. This skids through, meaning that Salt, who is trying to force it through the off side again, is a tad late on the stroke. Goes past the bat and thunders into the stumps!
and he gets thrashed for four! Marginally short on middle and off stump. Salt rocks onto the back foot and crunches it past extra cover!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Salt drops it into the off side and scampers across to the other end
full delivery darted into the batter's pads. Warner stabs it towards deep mid wicket for a single
short delivery on leg stump that hurries onto Warner. Can't time this one well and can only splice it towards mid on
Warner is on a roll! Back of a length delivery at the stumps again. Warner stays leg side of the ball, gives himself enough swinging room and smears it just over the deep mid wicket fence!
four more! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Warner has a swipe at it and muscles it over mid wicket
banged into the track on leg stump. Warner picks the length a little late and ducks underneath it hurriedly
slower delivery on a length on off stump. Salt comes forward and slices it towards backward point. He is intent for the single too but is sent back by Warner
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Warner advances and tips it down the ground before scampering across to the other end
short and wide outside off stump, and that is meat and drink for Warner! Has a free swing at it and lifts it over extra cover for another boundary!
oh dear! Back of a length delivery on off stump. Warner gives himself a bit of room and drills it towards mid off, who dives over it and lets in the boundary. PBKS have not been great so far!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Salt gets up on his toes and taps it into the off side for one more run
length delivery just outside off stump. Salt comes forward and jabs it towards short extra cover, where the fielder misfields and ends up conceding a couple
edged and four! Slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Warner goes fishing at it without much foot movement and gets a thick outside edge that flies past the keeper
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Salt gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep cover point

back of a length delivery that slides down the leg side. Jitesh does very well to grab it in his left mitt. Called a wide, though. PBKS have reviewed this, arguing that the ball might have hit the thigh pad on its way to the keeper. Looks like PBKS are right. The ball has indeed flicked the thigh pad, and the wide call has been reversed!
dug into the track outside off stump. Salt rocks back and pulls it powerfully towards deep square leg. Ellis runs to his left and reins it back in, courtesy a dive
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Warner guides it towards deep backward point for another single
disdainful! Slower delivery on off stump that sits up to be hit. Warner obliges and belts it over mid wicket for another boundary!
full delivery darted into leg stump. Salt comes down the track and swings at it. He misses, though, as the ball pings off the pads into the off side
length delivery angled into leg stump. Salt goes back and defends it with a straight bat
four more! Short and outside off again. Salt gets his hands through the ball and this time, bisects the gap between cover point and backward point!
shot! Fractionally short outside off stump. Salt picks the length early, goes deep into his crease and cracks it past cover for four!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Warner pulls it away towards deep mid wicket for a single
and Brar travels! Dragged down on middle and leg stump. This one sits up and Warner has all the time in the world to rock back and hammer it through mid wicket for four!
another cutter on off stump that grips in the surface and deviates away from Salt. He is squared up completely and beaten all ends up
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Salt does not quite pick it and nibbles at it, getting beaten by the lack of pace
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Warner jabs it towards deep cover point for one more run
gets it away! Back of a length delivery slanted into leg stump again. Warner uses the angle and helps it neatly past short fine leg for four!
back of a length delivery angled into leg stump. Warner plays all over it as the ball pings off the thigh pad into the off side
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Salt swings it away towards deep backward square leg for a single
back of a length delivery on leg stump that rushes onto Warner. He is hurried into his pull and can only splice it towards mid wicket
length delivery outside off stump. Salt comes half forward and drives it on the up towards deep backward point to get off the mark
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Warner uses the pace and runs it down to deep backward point for a single
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Warner gets behind the line of the ball and plays it with a straight bat
four more! Short, wide and punished! Too much width and Warner throws his hands at it, scything it past deep backward point
what a way to get off the mark! Dug into the track outside off stump. Warner rocks onto the back foot and razes it past mid wicket for four!
